voicechat_mic_toggle.config.title: Voice Chat Mic Toggle
voicechat_mic_toggle.config.reset.toolti: Put every setting back to its default
voicechat_mic_toggle.config.no_cloth: Install Cloth Config for the full settings screen
voicechat_mic_toggle.option.enabled.tool: Off, both keys work exactly as Simple Voice Chat makes them.
voicechat_mic_toggle.option.voice_mode.t:
Press to switch: one press turns the microphone on, the next one turns it off.
Tap or hold: a short tap switches it on until the next tap; hold the key longer than the threshold and it only talks while held.
Only while held: like a walkie-talkie, as without this mod.

Only matters with Push to Talk chosen as the activation type in Simple Voice Chat.
voicechat_mic_toggle.option.whisper_mode:
Press to switch: one press starts whispering, the next one stops.
Tap or hold: a short tap switches it on until the next tap; hold the key longer than the threshold and it only whispers while held.
Only while held: as without this mod.

Talking and whispering end each other: pressing one key switches the other off.
voicechat_mic_toggle.option.hold_thresho: For "Tap or hold": a press longer than this counts as holding, and letting go switches the microphone off again.
voicechat_mic_toggle.option.ignore_in_sc: Ignore keys in menus and chat
While a menu or the chat is open, keyboard keys do not switch anything, so typing the letter on the key does not open the microphone. Mouse buttons still work.
A short click when the microphone switches on or off; the whisper click is higher and quieter. Only you hear it.
voicechat_mic_toggle.option.announce.too: Shows "Microphone on", "Whispering" and so on over the hotbar every time something switches.
